relations: Viewpoint drift scales the wet mesh, making vertical wires appear finer toward the left.
The yellow-green textile slides toward the bottom-right, uncovering more of the pale bar and dark object.
As the frame shifts right with handheld wobble, the dark curved tan segments emerge beyond the bar.
Fixed droplet patches persist on the mesh without wiping or dripping during the reframing.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a wire mesh screen covered with droplets and damp patches. Fine vertical wires span the left and center. A bright yellow-green fuzzy textile sits along the right edge, overlapping a pale frame bar. Beyond the bar lies a dark object showing curved tan segments. The viewpoint drifts slowly, changing the wet pattern's scale so the wires look finer toward the left. As this reframing continues, the yellow textile slides toward the bottom-right corner, covering less of the right side. More of the dark object emerges, and the bar edges rightward with handheld wobble. The droplet patches remain mostly fixed, with no visible wiping or dripping.
